newsitem.title: GERMANY: Degussa to raise stake in Muro to 100 pct.
newsitem.headline: Degussa to raise stake in Muro to 100 pct.

text.p: Germany's Degussa AG said on Monday that its Asta Medica drugs unit would raise its stake in U.S.-based Muro Pharmaceuticals to 100 percent from 20 percent.
The total acquisition price for Muro Pharmaceutical, including the 20 percent-stake bought by Degussa earlier this year, will be $350 million, Degussa said.
The deal is still subject to cartel office approval.
Degussa said it would finance the majority of the purchase with 630,000 of its shares, translating into 31.5 million marks of the base capital, and an additional $100 million in cash.
Degussa also said that Asta held the option to a new product, for which more payments may need to be made in the next two years.
Muro Pharmaceuticals, located in Tewksbury, Massachusetts, specialises in respiratory drugs and posts annual sales of 120 million marks.
